prompt: Create one transparent Milo full-head/upper-chest neutral portrait-base candidate. Image 1 controls canonical identity/anatomy/material/palette; image 2 is the existing candidate portrait geometry inspiration, not approval; image 3 supplies stationary body/neck anatomy and upward-view inspiration only. Preserve skull/ear/head proportions, muzzle, green eyes, grey felt and cream upper chest. Turn head/eyeline right with physically plausible short neck and a compatible three-quarter view; body remains screen-right. Keep both ears entirely inside frame with ample margin, visible neck transition and shoulders. Neutral attentive closed-mouth expression, no teeth, speech shape or new head silhouette. No scenery, props, ground, shadow, text or watermark. Neutral studio light, real transparent alpha. New angle is a proposed geometry base requiring owner review before dependent expressions.
